claims: Monitor serum sodium closely and reassess fluid strategy, as sodium is elevated at 154–159 mEq/L with hypernatremia.
Monitor serum potassium and replace as indicated, given prior hypokalemia (2.7–3.6 mEq/L) and ongoing KPhos infusion.
Monitor magnesium and phosphate levels and replete as needed, given prior hypomagnesemia (1.7 mg/dL) and hypophosphatemia (1.2–1.6 mg/dL).
Assess and manage altered mental status and ICU delirium, with CAM-ICU inattention and disorientation noted.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin therapy per protocol, given hyperglycemia (glucose up to 138 mg/dL) and insulin infusion.
Monitor respiratory status and oxygen saturation, with low-normal SpO2 (92–94%) on supplemental oxygen and tachypnea.
Continue broad-spectrum antimicrobial therapy (piperacillin-tazobactam, vancomycin, azithromycin) and reassess response, given leukocytosis (WBC 20.6 K/uL) and possible infection.
Monitor blood pressure and hemodynamics, as blood pressure is low (systolic 91–106 mmHg, MAP 47–60 mmHg) with tachycardia risk.
Perform skin assessment and pressure ulcer care, with Braden score indicating high risk and a documented pressure ulcer.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit and assess for bleeding, given anemia (Hgb 10.7 g/dL) and hematuria (RBC 49/hpf).
